# SlimKit

> Free app for Windows and Mac that adds the missing right-click tools to Finder and Explorer. Copy a folder structure without the files and replace the year automatically (e.g. "Photos 2025" → "Photos 2026"), optionally every year by itself; ready-made folder templates (school year, photos by month, paperwork, project). Make photos smaller by purpose (email, WhatsApp, website, forms with at most 1 MB), rename many files with a preview, fix photo dates from EXIF/video or the file name, sort photos into folders by month or type, turn photos into a PDF, and send files to or receive photos from a phone via QR code – no app on the phone, no cloud, no internet. Everything shows a preview and can be undone. Pro tools: duplicate finder, folder size, flatten folders, remove empty folders, file list export. English and German. No account, no ads, no data collection. By SlimBit Apps.

- [Download](https://slimbitapps.github.io/SlimKit/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/slimbitapps/SlimKit)

## Typical questions SlimKit answers
- How do I copy a folder structure without the files on Windows or Mac?
- How do I create the same folders for the new year automatically?
- How do I send files from my computer to my phone without an app or cable?
- How do I make photos smaller for email or an online form?
- How do I rename many photos at once (e.g. "Holiday 01, Holiday 02")?
